title: Seo Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist 
 Job Summary We are looking for a results-driven SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to strengthen our online presence, increase website traffic, generate qualified leads, and improve search engine rankings. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SEO, content marketing, paid advertising, social media marketing, and web analytics, with a strong understanding of the latest digital marketing trends and search engine algorithms. 
 Key Responsibilities Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Develop and execute comprehensive on-page and off-page SEO strategies. Perform keyword research and competitor analysis. Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and technical SEO elements. Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Build high-quality backlinks through ethical link-building techniques. Conduct regular SEO audits and implement recommendations. Stay updated with Google algorithm updates and industry best practices. Content Marketing Plan and manage SEO-focused content strategies. Optimize blogs, landing pages, and service pages for search engines. Ensure content aligns with user intent and business objectives. Digital Marketing Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other paid campaigns. Optimize campaign performance to improve ROI and reduce acquisition costs. Execute email marketing and remarketing campaigns. Social Media Marketing Create and manage content calendars. Grow brand awareness through organic and paid social media campaigns. Monitor engagement and analyze campaign performance. Analytics & Reporting Track website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools. Prepare monthly reports on traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance. Provide actionable insights to improve the effectiveness of digital marketing. Website & Conversion Optimization Collaborate with developers to improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, and technical SEO. Optimize landing pages for higher conversion rates. Conduct A/B testing and recommend UX improvements. 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of On-Page, Off-Page, and Technical SEO. Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console. Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Knowledge of keyword research tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Ubersuggest. Understanding of HTML, CSS, and website structure is an advantage. Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms. Knowledge of backlink analysis and outreach strategies. Familiarity with local SEO and international SEO. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field. Google Ads Certification or Google Analytics Certification is preferred. Digital marketing certifications are an added advantage. 
 Experience 3-6 years of experience in SEO and Digital Marketing. Experience working with IT services, SaaS, software products, or digital agencies will be preferred. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Growth in organic website traffic. Improvement in keyword rankings. Increase in qualified leads generated. Growth in website conversion rate. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Cost per Lead (CPL). Organic backlinks acquired. Improvement in domain authority and website health score. Social media engagement and follower growth.

Key Skills: Social media,Link building,Engine,Searching,Search engine optimization,Research,Building,Hootsuite
